title: About | ReVita Global
content:
Senior hospitality thinking. Directly applied.
A boutique UK hospitality advisory and management company founded by Devendranath (Deven) Sookur.
About ReVita Global
ReVita Global Consulting Ltd is a UK-registered hospitality advisory and management company serving owners, investors, developers and leadership teams. The company was incorporated in England and Wales on 5 June 2025 under company number 16498465.
Founder
Devendranath (Deven) Sookur is the Founder and Principal Consultant. His career spans more than 30 years in hospitality, from frontline luxury service to senior multi-property executive leadership. [...] His experience includes hotel operations, rooms and food-and-beverage leadership, multi-site management, team leadership, operational restructuring, renovations, guest experience, commercial performance and the management of complex service-led businesses.
Leadership philosophy
ReVita’s work is grounded in three principles: understand the owner’s intent, confront operational reality and convert strategy into disciplined execution. Advice must be commercially relevant, implementable and accountable.
Geographic perspective
The founder’s international hospitality exposure includes the United Kingdom, Mauritius, the United States and Australia, providing a broad understanding of service cultures, operating environments and owner expectations.
Bring us the opportunity, challenge or ambition. [...] Bring us the opportunity, challenge or ambition.
Discreet strategic advisory and management support for hospitality owners, investors, developers and family offices.
